_about: #1480 vessel kit PREPARATION (parked kit, milestone 58), all DRAFT. Box list and draft rule cards for a pressure vessel datasheet, built only from the standards the library already holds (SAES-D-001). Every card is a draft: no engineer has signed it off, no real vessel document has proved it. Read only when `vessel_kit_draft_enabled` is on (off by default); every result is held for the engineer. Rule text is in our own words, never the standard's. Clause numbers and pages are as stored in the library and not verified. A card whose value no held clause requires stays draft 'needs ...' (order 301.1, A-1440). ASME VIII-1 is held, but 0 of its 4,073 stored rules carry ASME's own clause numbers, so no card cites an ASME clause as verified.
standards_held_unusable_for_citation: ASME BPVC VIII-1 (clause numbers in the library are not ASME's own)

cards.text: The design pressure is stated on the data sheet.
The design code, with its division and edition, is stated on the data sheet.
The minimum design metal temperature is stated on the data sheet.

The weld joint efficiency is at least 0.85 (85%). A figure printed as a percentage (70 or 85 %) is not judged: it is an engineer's question. Not checked: whether the vessel is built to the Division 1 code this clause is written for.

cards.text: The design pressure is at least 1.05 times the maximum operating pressure. Not checked: the larger factor of 1.1 (or the fixed offset) that the clause gives for a maximum operating pressure up to 6,900 kPa; the stored table text is garbled, so only the lowest factor in it is used. The check reads whichever operating pressure the sheet states, which may be the normal and not the maximum one.
